GridLayout.accessibilityLabel: Issues need attention. Tap to show them

Label.text: Android will slow Faceclaw to a crawl when the phone screen is off unless it is exempt from battery optimization.
The G2 fonts have not been extracted, so EvenHub apps will render with fallback fonts. Preparing them downloads the official firmware to extract its fonts; your glasses are not reflashed.
